text:
Maria Chen: FYI seeing authz weirdness after last night's KMS rekey/rotation. some embeddings requests are being accepted even though token scope is chat-only. :rotating_light:
Jun Park: wait what. can you paste a repro?
Maria Chen: repro in prod staging - quick curl: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -d "{\"input\":\"hello\"}" 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
```
The token has scope claim `scopes:["chat:invoke"]` (decoded JWT), but request succeeded and used `text-embed-001` model.
Sasha Iqbal: :eyes: do you have the decoded token blob? redact ofc.
Maria Chen: pasted masked: `iss: redwood, sub: acct-123, scopes:[chat:invoke], kid: kms-rot-2026-03-19, exp: 1710000000`
infra-bot: deploy 2134509000 finished to runtime-cluster-2 by ci/cd at 2134508600
Jun Park: timeline: KMS rotate at 2134507200, runtime deploy ~2134509000. could be a cache of old scope mapping?
Sasha Iqbal: I reproduced locally. Route-level enforcement checks `route_allowed_scopes` against token scopes but the embeddings handler calls the legacy `is_model_allowed_by_key` which uses cached route->model whitelist keyed by keytag that got re-homed during rotate. so after rotate the mapping returns `*` for some keys.
Liam O'Connor: that sounds like a stale cache returning fallback wildcard. we added fallback to keep things up during rotation, but it looks like it never healed.
Maria Chen: auditor logs also missing KMS key id on some requests. auditor-bot: found 73 events w/ missing `kms_key_id` between 2134507000 and 2134509500.
auditor-bot: audit:EVENTS: [redacted], sample: `user:svc-embed, route:/v1/embeddings, token_sub:acct-123, kms_key_id: null, effective_scopes:[chat:invoke]`
Kate Wu: if kms_key_id missing we can't tie tokens to rotation metadata; that could explain wrong cache routing.
Jun Park: immediate mitigation options?
Sasha Iqbal: short term: disable wildcard fallthrough in runtime config so requests with ambiguous mapping are rejected (quick flag). I can push a canary within 10m.
Maria Chen: do it + revoke the specific token(s) we saw as compromise proof. I put a revoke request for token id tok-zz-999.
Liam O'Connor: long term: (1) ensure route enforcement uses token scopes directly (no stale cache) (2) persist kms_key_id into every audit event at emission time (3) add rotate-safe rekey handshake so cache entries are atomically swapped.
Sasha Iqbal: Agreed. I'll open a PR to change embeddings handler to call unified authz check (non-cache) and add unit test that simulates rekey mapping flip. assigning to @Sasha. ETA EOD.
Kate Wu: I'll follow-up on the KMS side: investigate why kms_key_id was dropped by rekey lambda. might be a metadata propagation bug in kms-wrapper. assigning to @Kate, ETA tomorrow.
Jun Park: I'll own postmortem + severity classification. add to incidents channel and schedule triage at 1400.
Maria Chen: quick ask: does anyone know if Dedicated customers saw this?
Liam O'Connor: quick query shows 2 dedicated accounts hit embeddings route during window, no PII ingress. flagging AccountSec to notify customers as required.
infra-bot: rollback plan prepared: revert runtime flag that introduced wildcard fallthrough -> revert patch 2134508800 if needed.
Sasha Iqbal: after canary we should run the `scope-coherence` test which I added to CI - it runs simulated rotations and asserts no scope expansion. running now.
Maria Chen: thanks all. please add any audit evidence to the incident doc and add logs for the 73 events. I'll start a short incident note for SOC. :lock:
Jun Park: adding follow-ups: postmortem, test coverage, audit retention change, and a small alerts rule if `kms_key_id` is null more than X events/hour.
Kate Wu: note: KMS team suspects a race where metadata patcher returned 204 without body during rekey. will correlate with lambda logs.
Maria Chen: ok. will update thread with mitigation status.
Sasha Iqbal: canary applied to cluster-2, rejecting ambiguous mappings -> observed 12% error spike but authz now correct. rolling to cluster-1 in 5m.
Maria Chen: confirmed, errors expected. keeping this open until postmortem. :white_check_mark:
